chat_messages.text: Is anyone driving past the pharmacy today?
Lift on the first floor is working again.
Reminder: the new hoist slings are in the store room, old ones go back to the laundry.
New gloves size M are in the cupboard by the lift.
Hi Monika, could I have the 28th off next month? Happy to work the weekend before.
Thanks – I'll check and come back to you.
The GP round is moved to Thursday 11:00 this week.
Question for the boss: I'd need Saturday 28 November off, it's a family wedding. Would that be OK?
Thanks for staying on last night!
Maria, yes, that's fine – approved. I haven't put it in the system, the rota will take care of it.
Birthday cake in the staff room – help yourselves.
Hi, my training certificate is renewed – where should I send the copy?
Can whoever is on late tomorrow bring the menu cards down to the kitchen?
Thanks – I'll check and come back to you.
I'm on the moving and handling course on Sat 28 Nov, but the rota still has me on early. Can someone sort that?
Found it – it was in the handover folder.

home.user_title: Assistant to the Director of Nursing

attachments.content:
Mirenta Pflegepersonal
Rate card – from 1st of this month

Registered nurse: on request
Care assistant: on request

One hourly rate for every shift, nights and weekends included.
Minimum booking 6 hours. Cancellation free of charge up to 24 hours before the shift; later cancellations are charged in full.
Lead time: as stated in the booking portal for each offer.

mails.body:
Hello,

Attached is our updated rate card. Nothing changes for bookings already confirmed. As always, please book through the portal so the shift details are complete.

Best wishes
Sarah Hartmann
Mirenta Pflegepersonal
mails.subject: Updated rate card

mails.body:
Dear all,

Thank you for the last month's figures. Across the region overtime went up again. From now on I'll ask each home for a short reason when a planning period ends above the contracted hours. No action needed today.

Best regards
Jonas Schulz

mails.body:
Hello,

I think Mr Steiner left the new glasses in the dining room on Tuesday. Could someone have a look? I can bring the spare pair on Friday.

mails.subject: Glasses

mails.body:
Dear Monika,

Please find attached the hours we processed for October 2026. For the next run we need any changes to contracted hours, new starters and leavers by Fri 27 Nov 2026. Hours above or below contract go to each person's hours account and are balanced with time off; overtime is paid out only when the home manager approves it.

If any of the figures look wrong, reply to this mail with the staff number and the corrected hours – please do not edit the file.

Kind regards
Markus Schröder
Lohnbüro Sorantis
mails.subject: Payroll cut-off for October and next run

mails.body:
Dear Monika,

We have confirmed 4 places on our moving and handling refresher (practical) on Sat 28 Nov 2026 (08:30–16:00). Your practice instructor, Uwe Lehmann, sent us the names; please ask Uwe Lehmann about the list. As agreed with your manager, the attendees will be released from work for the day.

Kind regards
Kai Schneider
Bildungswerk Torlund
mails.subject: Confirmed: Moving and handling refresher (practical) on Sat 28 Nov

mails.body:
Hi Monika,

A few things for the coming days:
- overtime only where it is really needed – the regional office is watching hours closely
- please make sure everyone who is moved gets a shift message

I'm in meetings most of tomorrow morning; message me in the chat if something can't wait.

Ewa Kaya
